name: is-gpt-nerfed
description: Transparent, user-controlled detection of silent model downgrades in Codex sessions: a zero-token passive scan of the session rollout on every turn, plus ModelTrace fingerprint probes run in ephemeral forks of the thread (the mechanism behind /side) on a schedule you choose. Verdicts are delivered as a snarky card.

hooks.description: is-gpt-nerfed: passive session-integrity scan, probe scheduling, verdict delivery, optional halt

hooks.command: sh -c 'P="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; H="$P/skills/is-gpt-nerfed/scripts/hook.sh"; if [ ! -x "$H" ]; then N="${NERFED_HOME:-${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/is-gpt-nerfed}"; H="$N/plugin/skills/is-gpt-nerfed/scripts/hook.sh"; fi; [ -x "$H" ] || exit 0; sh "$H" SessionStart || true; exit 0'
hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$p=$env:PLUGIN_ROOT; $h=if($p){Join-Path $p 'skills\is-gpt-nerfed\scripts\hook.ps1'}; if(-not $h -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $h)){$n=$env:NERFED_HOME; if(-not $n){$c=$env:CODEX_HOME; if(-not $c){$c=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.codex'}; $n=Join-Path $c 'is-gpt-nerfed'}; $h=Join-Path $n 'plugin\skills\is-gpt-nerfed\scripts\hook.ps1'}; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $h){try{& $h -Event SessionStart}catch{}}; exit 0"

interface.shortDescription: Catch silent model downgrades in your Codex sessions
interface.longDescription: is-gpt-nerfed watches every Codex session for silent model, reasoning-effort and context-window changes (zero tokens), and on a schedule you choose forks the thread ephemerally to run ModelTrace fingerprint probes that attribute the answering model. Results arrive as a card, a macOS notification and a message in the thread. Everything stays on your machine. Fingerprint bank and scorer: github.com/xqy2006/ModelTrace (MIT).
defaultPrompt: Did Codex silently downgrade this session? Use $is-gpt-nerfed.
